description: Build one non-custodial swap via POST /swap/build on this host ($0.01 USDC on Base via x402). Returns best route found at quote time, itemized fees, guaranteed minimum received, and an unsigned transaction. This MCP wrapper does not take payment itself: call the HTTP endpoint, answer its 402 challenge, and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
name: swap_quote_build
title: Build a swap (paid, x402)
